info.name: USGS Earthquake Notifications, Feeds, and Web Services Catalog Monitoring Locations API
USGS Water Data Get Monitoring Locations

params.name: bbox
params.description: Bounding box spatial filter as [min_lon,min_lat,max_lon,max_lat]. Optionally include min_elev and max_elev for 6-coordinate form.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return (default 100, max 10000).

params.name: stateCd
params.description: Two-letter U.S. state or territory FIPS code (e.g., CA, TX, NY).

params.name: huc
params.description: Hydrologic Unit Code (2-12 digits) to filter by watershed.

params.name: siteType
params.description: USGS site type code (ST for streams, GW for groundwater, LK for lakes, AT for atmosphere, WE for wetlands, etc.).

items.docs: Retrieve USGS water monitoring locations (stream gages, groundwater wells, springs, etc.) as GeoJSON features. Supports spatial filtering by bounding box, attribute filtering by state/county/HUC, and pagination.

info.name: USGS Water Data Get Monitoring Location by ID

params.name: featureId
params.description: Monitoring location identifier in format AGENCY-SITENUMBER (e.g., USGS-11169025).

items.docs: Retrieve a single USGS water monitoring location by its feature identifier (site number with agency prefix, e.g., USGS-11169025).
